findings.description: Checkout step one cannot be completed: text typed in the Last Name field is written into the First Name field (Last Name stays empty), so 'Error: Last Name is required' is always shown even with all fields filled. Customers cannot check out.
repro: Add Sauce Labs Backpack to cart
Type Alice in First Name, Smith in Last Name, 12345 in Zip
Observe First Name now shows Smith, Last Name empty
Click Continue: 'Error: Last Name is required'

findings.description: Product sort dropdown has no effect: choosing Name (Z to A), Price (low to high) or Price (high to low) leaves the list in A-Z order and the control reverts to 'Name (A to Z)'.
repro: On Products page choose 'Price (low to high)' in the sort dropdown
Order of products does not change and dropdown shows Name (A to Z)

findings.description: Add to cart does nothing for Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt, Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket and Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) (item ids 1, 5, 3): button stays 'Add to cart', badge not incremented, item not in cart; the Add button on the detail page of these items also does nothing. Backpack, Bike Light and Onesie add fine.
repro: Click Add to cart on Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt (or Fleece Jacket / Red T-Shirt)
Cart badge does not change; open cart: item missing

findings.description: Remove button on the products list and on the product detail page does nothing: item stays in cart, badge count unchanged and button stays 'Remove'. Removing only works from the cart page.
repro: Click Remove on the products page (or on /inventory-item.html?id=4)

findings.description: The About link in the side menu points to https://saucelabs.com/error/404 (a 404 page) instead of a valid About page.
All six products show the same placeholder photo (a dog with a tennis ball, asset 'sl-404') instead of their own product images, on the list.
repro: Look at product images on Products page: all identical

notes: Could not test checkout overview/complete because step one is blocked (f1). Dynamic Catalog menu entry not explored in depth.
